notes.title: A Sceptic's Guide to Magic Set To Release on August 16Th (Wishlist/Follow Today)
notes.notes:
"A Sceptic's Guide to Magic" will be released on Friday 16th August!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/fa1127cbebb54d4860a172a63ac75aae6465c816.png

Birmingham, England: 1993. A shocking ritual murder compels a world-weary forensic investigator to discover a hidden realm of witchcraft, gods and demons. Follow clues and use magic to solve the case, with moral choices leading to multiple possible endings. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/e9f1b63c4f415adf969cb761265a4f076faebbe3.png

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Since last week's Steam client update, some players may have been experiencing crashes at certain points in the game. This problem should be fixed now.
    Some players have reported that achievements sometimes don't unlock. This update should resolve that issue.
